meta.name: Monitor brand mentions and route Slack alerts with Groq and Google News

name: Brand Monitor Template (Groq + Multi-Source-Ready + Severity Routing + Error Monitoring)

parameters.content:
## Brand Monitor Template (Groq + Multi-Source-Ready + Severity Routing + Error Monitoring)

### How it works

1. The workflow is triggered every 15 minutes.
2. It fetches data from Google News RSS and Reddit Search.
3. The data is then normalized and merged.
4. The workflow classifies the sentiment and intent of the data using Groq.
5. Based on the severity, it either logs everything or sends a high severity alert to Slack.

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Set up Google News RSS feed
- - [ ] Configure Reddit Search
- - [ ] Set up Groq API
- - [ ] Configure Slack for high severity alerts
- - [ ] Set up Google Sheets for logging

### Customization

You can customize the workflow by adding more data sources, modifying the normalization and merging process, and adjusting the severity thresholds.

## Trigger and Data Fetch

This group contains the trigger node and the nodes responsible for fetching data from Google News RSS and Reddit Search.

## Data Normalization

This group contains the nodes responsible for normalizing the data from Google News RSS and Reddit Search.

## Data Merging

This group contains the node responsible for merging the normalized data.

## Sentiment and Intent Classification

This group contains the nodes responsible for classifying the sentiment and intent of the data using Groq.

## Severity Based Alerting

This group contains the nodes responsible for sending high severity alerts to Slack.

## Logging and Error Handling

This group contains the nodes responsible for logging everything and handling errors.

nodes.name: Search Reddit
nodes.notes: Disabled by default - low mention volume for niche B2B use cases and Reddit blocks unauthenticated requests. Enable + add OAuth2 credential (register a 'script' app at reddit.com/prefs/apps) to use. After enabling, reconnect its output through Normalize Reddit Items -> a Merge node -> Dedupe/Cluster.

nodes.name: Get Trustpilot
nodes.notes: Disabled - no free Trustpilot/G2 API exists. Requires a paid Trustpilot Business API key or G2 partnership feed. Enable and wire through a Merge node into Dedupe/Cluster once you have credentials.

nodes.name: Merge Sources
nodes.notes: Currently bypassed since only Google News is active. Reconnect this node between your sources and Dedupe/Cluster if you enable Reddit and/or Trustpilot.
